capabilities.description: Slack API for channel/message workflows, workspace automation, and app-driven collaboration.

pricing.free_tier: API access included with Slack workspace/app usage; paid workspace features separate.

usage_terms.license: Slack platform terms and app review/rate-limit policies apply.
usage_terms.notes: Automated posting must respect anti-spam and rate-limit behavior.

data_governance.retention: Workspace retention/export policy controls message availability.
data_governance.lock_in_notes: Threads, reactions, and channel permissions are Slack-specific.

metrics.name: collaboration_api_fit

sla.rate_limit: Per-method, per-app, per-workspace tiers; posting messages generally no more than 1 message per second per channel.

approval.human_readable: Workspace-visible messages and destructive actions should require approval.

provenance.notes: Verified rate-limit tier model and message-posting guidance from official Slack API docs. SLA verified 2026-06: 99.99% uptime guarantee applies to paid Business+/Enterprise Grid plans (not the free tier); 100x credit policy.
